path.description: A non-empty project-relative or absolute path whose parsed path is normalized and does not start with a '..' segment. Dot and dot-dot segments are rejected. Repeated and trailing separators are treated as their parsed path. Hunk paths name the resolved target, including an absolute path for an external target.

kinds.description: The kinds into which you grouped the supplied development failures. A kind holds the failures whose trials first depart from the contract at the same action. Every supplied failure belongs to exactly one kind.

name.description: A short name for the action at which the kind's trials depart from the contract.

failures.description: The ids of the supplied failures that belong to the kind.

hunks.description: The ids of the hunks that address the kind. At least one for a routing or guidance kind; empty for a not_guidance or conflict kind.
Each changed hunk, as defined in the hunk definition supplied with this schema, exactly once. Use an empty array when no file changes.

id.description: Your id for the hunk, unique in this report, which the kinds that it addresses name.

dissimilar.description: The id of a test in the confirmed contract whose turns must not receive the new guidance.

needed_edits.description: Each edit that a requirement needs but that you did not make because it lies outside your authority. Empty if there is none.

requirement.description: The contract's identifier of the requirement that needs the edit.

conflicts.description: Conflicts already held by the confirmed prompt system. Empty when no kind is classified conflict.

failures.description: The supplied failure ids explained by this conflict.

requirement_ids.description: The distinct confirmed contract requirement ids that cannot be satisfied together.

quotations.description: Exact text from the confirmed prompt files that causes the conflict, rather than text introduced by campaign edits.

text.description: Non-blank text copied exactly from the file in the confirmed prompt system.

resolutions.description: Distinct changes to the requirements that resolve the conflict, in presentation order.

recommended.description: The 1-based position of the recommended resolution in resolutions.

reason.description: Why the recommended resolution best preserves what the prompt evidently intends.
